messages.author: Andy
messages.text:
i have a bauxite surplus in this province alone yet the game says only 56% of my inputs are produced domestically.

where's the 44% wtf

messages.author: Affairs and Order
messages.text: <@1180720719060029500> Hey Andy, thanks for flagging this. The 56% was a calculation bug, not your economy. The vertical integration share was using your mines' *base* rate instead of what they actually produce with all your boosts applied. That made it look like you were short on bauxite when you really have a surplus. The fix now measures real, boosted output. It's done and waiting in a PR for the next release. It's calculated per province, so each province gets its own figure based on its own buildings. Sorry for the confusion!
